why: Building and parsing a channel subject happens four times. A builder that emits a different shape than the parser expects means published events are never routed — again with no error anywhere.

cases.why: a topic may contain slashes and dots and is passed through unchanged
round trip: the FIRST dot after the channel ends it, the rest is the topic
a mailbox subject is not a channel subject
a channel subject with no topic is malformed
no tenant segment: refused rather than parsed with a guessed tenant
a wildcard in the CHANNEL would turn one publish into a broadcast
a wildcard in the TOPIC is the same problem
an empty channel is not a segment
